rules: Download to owned local demo asset directory; never hotlink in the demo.

For altered CC BY-SA images distribute the derivative under its same license; do not claim share-alike relicenses unrelated application code.
No legal, brand affiliation or photographed-stock ownership claim. All prices and sellers are synthetic.
Do not enable production import/reset. Preserve real listings.
